title: 3Sum
statement:
Given an integer array nums, return all the triplets [nums[i], nums[j], nums[k]] such that i != j != k != i and nums[i] + nums[j] + nums[k] == 0.

The solution set must not contain duplicate triplets. You may return the solution set in any order.

visibleExamples.explanation: nums[0] + nums[1] + nums[2] = (-1) + 0 + 1 = 0 and nums[1] + nums[2] + nums[4] = 0 + 1 + (-1) = 0. The distinct triplets are [-1,0,1] and [-1,-1,2].
The distinct triplets that sum to zero are [-2,0,2] and [-2,1,1].
